title: 1 ECS for plots up to 250 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 11.7, Plotted Housing a)

citations.original_text: a. 1.0 ECS in plots of size upto 250 sqm

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.222. New in MPD-2047: UBBL p.154 (viii) gave no ECS norm below 250 sqm. Metro and MLP deductions are 'NP' (not permitted) for plotted housing. effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E), as for Table 7.2. Supersedes the UBBL rule for the same plots from that date.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 Table 11.7: if the permissible FAR is not achieved with this parking norm, the norm of the smaller plot category applies. Not modelled; check with the sanctioning authority.
